submission.justification: L2 at 36 GeV gives the highest simulated efficiency (92.25%), well above L3 (84.1%) and L1 (73.0%). However, no latency figures were found for any candidate, so the hard 4.0 us latency limit is unverified for L2. The latency must be confirmed on FPGA hardware or in the documentation before deployment. If L2 fails the limit, the fallback is L3 at 40 GeV, which is also unverified.
